plan.summary: This 1-4 block is a simple off-camp build for boxing with one weekly S&C session that supports high sport practice instead of competing with it. Week 1 establishes a baseline on the main squat pattern, then Weeks 2-4 build crisp lower-body power, general strength, upper-body support work, trunk strength, and brief safe neck and grip work. Keep the lifting quality high and leave the session feeling trained, not drained.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength and explosive basics with low-complexity exercises that fit around sparring and skill work.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength and power lifts while trimming any work that starts to interfere with boxing volume.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength rising enough to support sharper, faster outputs with more emphasis on crisp explosive work.
